documents_expected.why: call page: eligibility, how to apply, obligations, dates
the required proposal template (served from static1.squarespace.com)

eligibility.rule: Conservationists residing in primate range countries
eligibility.quote: Our Annual Grants Program is open to conservationists residing in primate range countries who are engaged in applied biodiversity research, public or environmental health, or locally rooted conservation action.

eligibility.rule: A clear connection to non-human primate conservation
eligibility.quote: Applicants must demonstrate a clear and meaningful connection to non-human primate conservation.

eligibility.rule: Aligns with the mission and at least one core objective
eligibility.quote: Projects must also align with TDARFAC's mission and at least one of our three core objectives:

eligibility.rule: Awarded to a named individual lead, not an institution
eligibility.quote: Funding will be awarded to a named individual Principal Investigator or project lead rather than directly to an institution.

eligibility.rule: Proposal in English on the TDARFAC template, with no identifying information
eligibility.quote: Submissions that do not follow the required format will not be reviewed.
alt_quotes: Documents must be submitted in English.
Project proposals themselves must not contain names or other personal identifying information so that reviewers can evaluate proposals without knowing the identity of the applicant.

documents.quote: Prepare Your Project Proposal Using the TDARFAC Template.
alt_quotes: Project proposals must use this official TDARFAC proposal template.

documents.item: Budget table with justification and exchange rate
documents.quote: Present your budget in table form including unit price, quantity, total (local currency and USD), and justification notes.
Student Principal Investigators must submit two letters of support.

documents.item: Animal-handling protocol signed by two vets (capture or sedation)
documents.quote: Projects involving capture or sedation must submit a protocol signed by two DVMs directly to TDARFAC.

effort.step: Write the proposal on the template
effort.quote: Prepare Your Project Proposal Using the TDARFAC Template.

effort.step: Complete the online application form and upload the proposal
effort.quote: Application Deadline: 23:59 Central Standard Time (CST) on January 8, 2027
alt_quotes: Complete the Online Application Form. A Google Account is required for the submission process.

after_award.quote: Grant recipients must submit a final report in English within six (6) months of project completion.

notes: Up to $5,000 (six months or less) or $10,000 (longer). Recipients also track KPIs, an issue log and a risk assessment, and complete a self-assessment. The template PDF redirects to static1.squarespace.com; gather-2 skipped it as offsite before the redirect fix. The Malagasy writing guides and the .pptx are writing aids, not rules.
